title: SWIPER: Minimizing Fault-Tolerant Quantum Program Latency via Speculative Window Decoding
problem: Parallel window decoding for fault-tolerant quantum error correction requires some decoding tasks to be delayed until preceding windows complete, creating head-of-line blocking that inflates program runtime, especially during T gate teleportation where decoding latency directly extends logical circuit depth.
motivation: Future fault-tolerant quantum computers require real-time decoders that meet throughput demands, but existing parallel window decoders introduce sequential data dependencies that unnecessarily lengthen program runtimes.
method: SWIPER introduces a speculative window decoder inspired by classical branch prediction. A lightweight speculation step predicts data dependencies between adjacent decoding windows, allowing multiple layers of decoding tasks to begin simultaneously rather than waiting for dependency resolution. If speculation is wrong, the decoder rolls back and re-decodes; the state-of-the-art compilation pipeline ensures that speculation opportunities are maximized. Performance is evaluated using a detailed open-source cycle-accurate simulator.
key_novelty: Applying speculative execution—predicting inter-window data dependencies before they are resolved—to quantum error correction window decoders, eliminating blocking at window boundaries.
contributions: SWIPER speculative window decoder that predicts inter-window data dependencies to enable simultaneous multi-layer decoding.
40% average reduction in application runtime compared to prior parallel window decoders.
Integration with a state-of-the-art fault-tolerant compilation pipeline to maximize speculation benefit.
Detailed open-source simulator for evaluating speculative decoding strategies.

metrics.speedup: 40% average application runtime reduction vs. prior parallel window decoders

limitations: Misprediction rate and its penalty cost are not quantified in the abstract; performance may degrade for algorithms with highly variable dependency patterns.
primary_theme: Speculative window decoding for fault-tolerant quantum circuits
